segments.text: And Tobias called Raphael, and said to him,
segments.speaker: Tobias

segments.text: “Brother Azarias, take with you a servant and two camels, and go to Rages of Media to Gabael, and receive the money for me, and bring him to the wedding feast,
segments.speaker: Tobias

segments.text: because Raguel has sworn that I must not depart.
segments.speaker: Tobias

segments.text: My father counts the days; and if I wait long, he will be very grieved.
segments.speaker: Tobias

segments.text: So Raphael went on his way, and lodged with Gabael, and gave him the handwriting; so he brought forth the bags with their seals, and gave them to him.
segments.speaker: Tobias

segments.text: Then they rose up early in the morning together, and came to the wedding feast. Tobias blessed his wife.
segments.speaker: Tobias
